notes.title: Time mode, negative mode, brightness control and window mode
notes.content:
All of this has been updated in patch 1.3! Let's go into more detail about each feature  that has been added to the game in this major update.

[olist]
[*] The most important addition is the timer, the display of which you can enable in the settings. At the end of the level, you'll see the time it took you to complete it anyway. Also on the level selection screen you will see your best time to complete the level and the current time if you haven't finished yet. You can try to complete each level in record time and then share a screenshot.

[*] The level selection screen has also undergone some minor changes. Now you can see the progress on each level, how many cats you have already collected. And also a check mark will appear next to the level when it is passed.

[*] Many people did not know about the pause menu, where, by the way, there are different colors for cats. Now you can switch to it both by pressing Esc key and the button from the level, located next to the hint button.

[*] In the settings you can now click on the windowed mode button to switch the game to it, or back to full screen.

[*] A brightness bar has been added to the settings so that you can turn it to a comfortable level.

[*] Negative mode has been added to the settings. When activated, black and white colors on the level will be reversed, and you will be able to explore a black map with black cats on it.
[/olist]

We tried to satisfy all users who left their opinions in discussions and reviews. If you have any interesting and unusual ideas that could be added to this game or our future games, the next of which will be released this month, then feel free to write in comments, discussions or reviews. Thank you all for your participation, your feedback really helps to make the game better!

notes.title: Saving progress on the levels
notes.content:
In this update we have added support for saving on the levels. Now progress is not lost when you exit to the main menu, and you will be able to continue where you left off. Both the number of found cats and their colors are saved. If you want to replay the level - now there is a button to restart it on the level itself.  When restarting and re-entering a level, the hint recharge is activated again.

Let's be honest, we didn't initially conceive this functionality and didn't see the point in it, as the game is played in a few minutes. In addition, it would have taken away the possibility of replayability, which is relevant for the different colors that could be used. But, seeing some feedback from players, we realize that it is important for people to save progress on levels, so we are adding such functionality now.

notes.title: Choose your own name for the achievement! 🔥
notes.content:
Hi friends, with the addition of 100 achievements to the game we have a great idea. Anyone of you can suggest a cat name that will be one of the achievements in our upcoming game! 

Here is a small list of the rules according to which, we will be selecting names:
[list]

[*] 1 name per person
[*] Write the name in English, otherwise it will be localized
[*] No obviously absurd, forbidden, offensive names.
[*] You can submit at any time in the comments, up to the day of the game's release
[/list]
That's it! We'll put everyone who wants to participate in the achievement and link it to a random cat on the map, after the release you will be able to unlock this achievement in the game. Thanks for your participation, we hope you like this interactive format and we will apply it again in the future.

notes.title: 🐱 Hello cat lovers! Welcome to the game page ⛄️
notes.content:
I hope this game can warm you up a little bit in this snowy winter. Just look for the cats and enjoy all the shades of meow. It's free!

First of all, I want to thank everyone for the support, who adds the game to wishlist or just visits the page. This is my first game in this genre and this engine, so I would love your feedback and reviews to make this and future games even better!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2762810/Hidden_Winter_Cats/

The game is very casual and simple - you have to find 100 cats in a snowy location in 4k resolution. The art itself is hand drawn, as are all the cats. Most of them are easy to find, but some can be well hidden and shy of people. This is where the hint button will help you find the occasional hidden cat on the map. But don't use it too often - it has a cooldown.

You also have variability in choosing colors to paint - 5 bright colors that can be changed at any time in the pause menu. Red, blue, green, pink, yellow. You can paint different cats in different colors or make them all one color - at your discretion! Create your own painting. 

All cats are unique in both appearance and sounds. Some are happy to be found. Some, on the other hand, don't really want to be disturbed. Feel all the shades of meow! Also, the game has no words, is intuitive and suitable for all ages.

https://youtu.be/8y9k0X4sJiY

And finally the most important thing - the game is completely free! No paid content that is locked to you from the moment you start playing the game. If people like the game, the game will have sequels, with new unusual places to find cats. If you want to support the author - two DLCs are available, which do not affect the gameplay in any way. This is the soundtrack, which contains the main New Year's theme from the game. And this is the artbook, which is a 4k artwork containing a complete picture of the background and the kitties. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2788180/Hidden_Winter_Cats__Soundtrack/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2789900/Hidden_Winter_Cats__Artbook/

But the most important support for me is your review on the game. It passes very quickly, in 2-5 minutes, but I hope it will manage to give you pleasant and positive emotions. So any feedback will be very useful for me and for potential sequels for the game. 

Best regards,
Faithy
